text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: King Halo drags me along to practice her peculiar call and response routine: "What's my name?" "King Halo!" A bit shameless, but at least she's in great form.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her next stunt involves organizing a press interview during a training session. However, a disapproving Air Groove puts a stop to it and challenges King's actions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Like King Halo, Air Groove is the daughter of a famous racer. She attempts to share some advice, but King Halo isn't in the mood to hear it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: King Halo remains bent on gaining the recognition of the public—who regards her as little more than her mother's daughter—and of her mother herself, who refuses to acknowledge her daughter's talent.
